requirement.description: Several simulator command classes (Delay, Tick, NegEdgeTrigger, Settle, Passive, Active) have incomplete async iteration implementations that cause TypeError when used in testbenches. The tests expect these objects to be usable in 'await' expressions but they currently raise StopAsyncIteration immediately.

contract.description: Fix async iteration implementations for simulator commands to properly support 'await' expressions and testbench operations.

behavior.description: Delay, Tick, NegEdgeTrigger, Settle, Passive, and Active classes should properly implement __aiter__ and __anext__ methods to support async iteration.

outputs.output: Should allow proper await usage in testbenches

requirement.description: The Processor class creates hardware modules that cannot be pickled due to inclusion of module objects in its internal state, causing TypeError when used with concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor in test_crc_bytes, test_crc_words, and test_crc_match.

contract.description: Ensure Processor class instances can be pickled by removing or properly serializing module objects.

behavior.description: Processor instances should be serializable to enable concurrent processing in test environments.

requirement.description: Domain lookup mechanism fails to correctly compare ClockDomain objects, causing AssertionError when checking domain equality in test_domain_lookup. The comparison of ClockDomain objects returns different objects despite being logically equivalent.

contract.description: Fix domain lookup to properly compare ClockDomain objects for equality.

behavior.description: Domain lookup should correctly identify equivalent ClockDomain objects and return the same domain instance when queried.

inputs.input: Equivalent ClockDomain objects with same properties

outputs.output: Consistent domain lookup results regardless of object identity
